blurb: This check scans the recent system error log for early warning signs that a hardware component is failing, such as disk errors, SAN or SCSI path faults, power or thermal events, memory errors, lost logical volumes, adapter resets, and dump-device faults. These are the patterns that show a part is wearing out before it fails completely. If they go undetected, a disk, memory module, or storage path can fail without warning and take the system down in an unplanned outage.
